summary_zh: 泰中簽署八項合作，涵蓋EV投資與勞工技能發展；BOI公布第三季實際投資年增28%，全年預估破1兆泰銖，自動化與人才升級需求隨之升溫。環保管控持續趨嚴，工業部擬加強礦物進出口管制，工業聯合會推動廢棄物PRO系統；石化業則擔憂泰UAE FTA降稅過快衝擊原料成本。
summary_en: Thailand-China signed 8 pacts spanning EV investment and skills; BOI says Q3 actual investment rose 28%, full year seen above THB1 trillion. Environmental controls tighten (mineral trade rules, FTI waste PRO model), while petrochemical firms fear fast Thai-UAE FTA tariff cuts on PE/PP imports.
